name: Point Cloud Segmentation
description: Segment a point cloud into meaningful regions using geometric methods: RANSAC plane fitting and DBSCAN clustering.

videos.title: PointNet Point Cloud Segmentation & Stereo Depth Estimation

theory.overview:
Point cloud segmentation partitions a set of 3D points $P = \{p_1, \ldots, p_n\}$ into disjoint subsets corresponding to semantic or geometric regions.

RANSAC-based plane fitting iteratively fits a plane model $\vec{n} \cdot \vec{x} + d = 0$ to random point subsets.

DBSCAN groups points based on density: a point is a core point if it has at least $n_{\min}$ neighbors within radius $\epsilon$.

ransac_plane.title: RANSAC Plane Segmentation
ransac_plane.content: RANSAC iteratively fits a plane model and identifies inliers within distance threshold $\epsilon$. Plane inliers are colored distinctly from outliers.

dbscan_clustering.title: DBSCAN Clustering
dbscan_clustering.content: DBSCAN groups points based on density. Given parameters $(\epsilon, n_{\min})$, connected core points form clusters. Each cluster gets a unique color.

parameters.name: distance_threshold
parameters.description: Maximum distance from point to plane for inlier.

parameters.name: ransac_n
parameters.description: Number of points sampled to estimate each plane candidate.

parameters.name: probability
parameters.description: Expected probability of finding the best plane (early-stop confidence).

parameters.name: eps
parameters.description: Maximum distance between two points in same cluster.

parameters.name: min_points
parameters.description: Minimum points to form a cluster.

parameters.name: print_progress
parameters.description: Print an Open3D progress bar during clustering.
